raceTrait.defensiveTraining: Defensive Training: dodge bonus to AC against giants
raceTrait.hatred: Hatred: +1 attack vs. a favored enemy race
raceTrait.hardy: Hardy: +2 saves vs. poison, spells and spell-like abilities
raceTrait.stability: Stability: +4 CMD vs. bull rush/trip while standing on the ground
raceTrait.greed: Greed: +2 Appraise on items made of precious metal/gems
raceTrait.slowAndSteady: Slow and Steady: speed never reduced by armor or encumbrance
raceTrait.elvenImmunities: Elven Immunities: immune to sleep, +2 saves vs. enchantment
raceTrait.elvenMagic: Elven Magic: +2 vs. spell resistance checks, +2 Spellcraft to identify magic items
raceTrait.elfWeaponFamiliarity: Weapon Familiarity: longbow, longsword, rapier, shortbow
raceTrait.gnomeMagic: Gnome Magic: bonus spell-like abilities, +1 DC on illusion spells
raceTrait.obsessive: Obsessive: +2 to one Craft or Profession skill
raceTrait.adaptability: Adaptability: gains Skill Focus as a bonus feat at 1st level
raceTrait.elfBlood: Elf Blood: counts as both elf and human
raceTrait.orcBlood: Orc Blood: counts as both orc and human
raceTrait.orcFerocity: Orc Ferocity: once per day, fight on for one more round below 0 hp
raceTrait.halfOrcWeaponFamiliarity: Weapon Familiarity: falchion, orc double axe
raceTrait.halflingLuck: Halfling Luck: +1 on all saving throws

agileManeuvers.name: Agile Maneuvers
agileManeuvers.description: Use Dex modifier instead of Str for combat maneuver checks.

blindFight.name: Blind-Fight
blindFight.description: Reroll miss chance from concealment; enemies get no bonus vs. you when you're blinded.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.description: Extra melee attack against an adjacent foe after downing one.

combatCasting.name: Combat Casting
combatCasting.description: +4 concentration checks to cast defensively or while grappled.

combatExpertise.name: Combat Expertise
combatExpertise.description: Trade attack bonus for a dodge bonus to AC.

combatReflexes.name: Combat Reflexes
combatReflexes.description: Extra attacks of opportunity per round.

deadlyAim.name: Deadly Aim
deadlyAim.description: Trade a ranged attack penalty for extra damage.

deflectArrows.name: Deflect Arrows
deflectArrows.description: Deflect one ranged weapon attack per round as if with a shield.

diehard.name: Diehard
diehard.description: Automatically stabilize and can act while at negative hp.

endurance.name: Endurance
endurance.description: +4 on checks to resist nonlethal damage and fatigue.

greatCleave.name: Great Cleave
greatCleave.description: Cleave with no limit on the number of extra attacks per round.
greatCleave.prerequisite: Str 13, Cleave, Power Attack, base attack bonus +4

improvedBullRush.name: Improved Bull Rush
improvedBullRush.description: No attack of opportunity when bull rushing; +2 on the check.

improvedCounterspell.name: Improved Counterspell
improvedCounterspell.description: Counter a spell with one of the same school, not just the same spell.

improvedCritical.name: Improved Critical
improvedCritical.description: Double the threat range of one weapon.

improvedDisarm.name: Improved Disarm
improvedDisarm.description: No attack of opportunity when disarming; +2 on the check.

improvedFeint.name: Improved Feint
improvedFeint.description: Feint as a move action instead of a standard action.

improvedGrapple.name: Improved Grapple
improvedGrapple.description: No attack of opportunity when grappling; +2 on the check.

improvedOverrun.name: Improved Overrun
improvedOverrun.description: No attack of opportunity when overrunning; +2 on the check.

improvedShieldBash.name: Improved Shield Bash
improvedShieldBash.description: Keep your shield's AC bonus when shield bashing.

improvedSunder.name: Improved Sunder
improvedSunder.description: No attack of opportunity when sundering; +2 on the check.

improvedTrip.name: Improved Trip
improvedTrip.description: No attack of opportunity when tripping; +2 on the check.

improvedTwoWeaponFighting.name: Improved Two-Weapon Fighting
improvedTwoWeaponFighting.description: Gain a second off-hand attack at a -5 penalty.
improvedTwoWeaponFighting.prerequisite: Dex 17, Two-Weapon Fighting, base attack bonus +6

improvedUnarmedStrike.name: Improved Unarmed Strike
improvedUnarmedStrike.description: Unarmed strikes count as a weapon and never provoke.

manyshot.name: Manyshot
manyshot.description: Fire two arrows with one attack at the highest bonus.
manyshot.prerequisite: Dex 17, Point-Blank Shot, Rapid Shot, base attack bonus +6

mobility.name: Mobility
mobility.description: +4 AC against attacks of opportunity from movement.

mountedCombat.name: Mounted Combat
mountedCombat.description: Once per round, negate a hit on your mount with a Ride check.

pointBlankShot.name: Point-Blank Shot
pointBlankShot.description: +1 attack and damage with ranged weapons within 30 ft.

powerAttack.name: Power Attack
powerAttack.description: Trade a melee attack penalty for extra damage.

preciseShot.name: Precise Shot
preciseShot.description: No penalty for shooting into melee.

rapidShot.name: Rapid Shot
rapidShot.description: One extra ranged attack per round at -2 to all attacks.

run.name: Run
run.description: Run at 5x normal speed (4x in armor); +4 Acrobatics for jump distance.

shotOnTheRun.name: Shot on the Run
shotOnTheRun.description: Move, fire a ranged attack, then move again.
shotOnTheRun.prerequisite: Dex 13, Dodge, Mobility, Point-Blank Shot, base attack bonus +4

skillFocus.name: Skill Focus
skillFocus.description: +3 (or +6 at 10 ranks) to one chosen skill.

springAttack.name: Spring Attack
springAttack.description: Move in, attack, and move out without provoking.
springAttack.prerequisite: Dex 13, Dodge, Mobility, base attack bonus +4

toughness.name: Toughness
toughness.description: +3 hit points, +1 more per level after 3rd.

vitalStrike.name: Vital Strike
vitalStrike.description: Roll one weapon's damage dice an extra time on a single attack.

weaponFinesse.name: Weapon Finesse
weaponFinesse.description: Use Dex instead of Str on attack rolls with light weapons.

weaponFocus.name: Weapon Focus
weaponFocus.description: +1 attack rolls with one chosen weapon.

detectMagic.name: Detect Magic
detectMagic.description: Detects spells and magic items nearby.

acidSplash.name: Acid Splash
acidSplash.description: Ranged touch attack deals 1d3 acid damage.

dancingLights.name: Dancing Lights
dancingLights.description: Creates up to four floating lights.

mending.name: Mending
mending.description: Repairs a small break or tear.

guidance.name: Guidance
guidance.description: +1 on one attack roll, save, or skill check.

magicMissile.name: Magic Missile
magicMissile.description: Unerring darts deal 1d4+1 force damage each.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: +4 shield bonus to AC, blocks magic missile.

charmPerson.name: Charm Person
charmPerson.description: Makes one humanoid regard you as a trusted friend.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.description: Puts 4 HD of creatures into a magical slumber.

grease.name: Grease
grease.description: Makes a surface or object slippery.

summonMonsterI.name: Summon Monster I
summonMonsterI.description: Summons an outsider to fight for you.

protectionFromEvil.name: Protection from Evil
protectionFromEvil.description: +2 AC/saves vs. evil, blocks mental control by evil creatures.

jump.name: Jump
jump.description: Gives a bonus on Acrobatics checks made to jump.

bless.name: Bless
bless.description: Allies gain +1 attack rolls and +1 on saves vs. fear.

command.name: Command
command.description: One creature obeys a single-word command.

doom.name: Doom
doom.description: One creature takes a penalty on attacks, damage, saves and checks.

entangle.name: Entangle
entangle.description: Plants entangle everyone in the area.

faerieFire.name: Faerie Fire
faerieFire.description: Outlines subjects in light, negating concealment.

companionQuality.wolfTrip: Trip: a bite that hits can attempt to trip the target
companionQuality.grantsPerceptionDark: Master gains +3 Perception in shadows or darkness
companionQuality.grantsMaxHp: Master gains +1 hp per master level
